       jsonb_build_object(

         'city_code', a.city_code, 'city_name', c.city_name,
         'ticket_price_fen', a.ticket_price_fen, 'currency', 'CNY', 'status', a.status,
         'location', jsonb_build_object('lat', a.latitude, 'lon', a.longitude),
